text:
maya: Heads-up — finance flagged a growing delta between hosted demand and our committed GPU pool for us-west and eu-west. seeing sustained 12% above committed last 2 weeks :thinking:
aj: Ack. Is the delta concentrated on a model family or global burst windows?
maya: Mostly gen-2 models (chat-xl variants) during business hours US. EU bump looks like nightly batch reruns.
linh: Can you paste the quick numbers?
maya: Short snapshot from last 7 days:
```
region,avg_hosted_tokens_per_min,committed_gpus,util_pct_est
us-west, 95k, 120, 104%
eu-west, 48k, 40, 120%
asia, 12k, 20, 60%
```
maya: That 120% in eu-west is the scary one, it's causing fallthroughs to burst which costs ~1.6x on overage.
infra-bot: Billing alert: overage charges projected at ~$18k this month if current trend continues.
carmen: Do we have elasticity left in Dedicated pools to absorb short spikes without incurring cloud overage?
noah: We have ~8 spare A100s in dedicated-us-west but they’re tagged for reserved tenants. Reassigning needs approval.
aj: Suggested short-term mitigations: 1) Move low-priority batch reruns to off-peak EU window 2) Enable prefix caching for chat-xl where applicable 3) Ramp up traffic routing to dedicated us-west for specific routes.
linh: For forecasting: if we assume 8% weekly growth and current QA rollouts finish, we hit ~135% util in eu-west in 3 weeks. We need either +16 GPUs there or reduce hosted QPS by ~20%.
maya: Agree. Also can we model cost: reserved add vs overage? Quick calc: adding 16 committed H100-equivalent per month ~= $52k vs overage projection $18k this month but likely scales up.
carmen: Finance prefers commitments > on-demand if sustained >6 weeks. We should run a 4-week conservative forecast and then queue an approval ask.
noah: Operational risk: provisioning extra capacity in eu-west has lead time 7–10 days for reservations. If we decide to buy, need slack-reservations sign-off by EOD Friday.
aj: Action items:
- maya: update 4-week forecast with separate model-level slices and put into shared sheet (https://go.redwood/reports/gpu-commit-forecast) — due tomorrow noon.
- linh: run a simulation of routing 15% of chat-xl to dedicated-us-west and measure tail latency impact — due 48h.
- carmen: check procurement cadence and draft a purchase memo if the forecast crosses our threshold.
- noah: list reassignable dedicated instances and owners.
maya: I'll also add a prompt-level cache opt recommendation to the Optimize team to squeeze down token counts for the worst offenders.
linh: FYI: if we can't change routing, another quick win is to tighten our per-route burst caps for non-SLA routes. small perf trade-off but big cost wins.
carmen: +1. finance will want the savings model before committing.
aj: Thanks all. If anyone sees a sudden spike, ping @here and tag infra-bot so billing can recalc in real time. :thumbsup:
maya: Filed the sheet and added notes. I'll post a short summary in Tuesday's capacity sync.
infra-bot: Note: next billing forecast refresh scheduled in 2h.
